findings.title: Keep the unresolved navigation obligation across a zero-input refused successor
findings.trigger: First guide click has completed delivery but remains pending/unknown after two read-only attempts. ROOT performs a new inspect and submits the allowed fresh 17-field supervised intent. That intent reaches begin_startup_navigation, then foreground is lost before publication, so the second attempt is refused with zero input. After another inspect, submit an ordinary native guide reviewed_plan without the source/17-field supervisor annotation.
findings.observed_bad_outcome: The third plan returns expected_title_observed and publishes a second simulated click. Its source is native_visual_guard and prior_unknown_navigation_request_id is null, although the original pending archive is unchanged and remains unknown.
findings.why_guards_do_not_prevent_it: save_startup_navigation always overwrites startup-navigation.json. The second attempt's refusal changes the pointer to status=refused/publication_attempted=false. check_startup_navigation_attempt only enforces completed delivery plus a fresh supervisor annotation when that one pointer is pending and published, so it never follows the second record's prior_unknown_navigation_request_id. New request/job IDs avoid the same-request and guide-intent dedup checks. Current native source, foreground, epoch and preparation guards still pass; they do not restore the missing pending obligation.
findings.impact: Breaks the documented supervisor-only fallback after an unknown navigation. This probe used the original reviewed_plan consumer with an ordinary native action, not a real autonomous game run. No physical input occurred; the original receipt, unknown outcome and two-read budget were preserved.
findings.required_change: Preserve an authenticated unresolved-obligation pointer separately from the latest attempt, or follow and validate the prior-unknown chain when a successor was refused before publication. A zero-input successor must not clear the older pending requirement. Retain all original reports and same-ID reads, and continue requiring a fresh explicit supervisor proof before a new click while that obligation remains unresolved.
findings.smallest_regression: Extend the existing guide consumer test with pending/unknown -> fresh supervised intent -> foreground refusal before publication -> fresh inspect -> ordinary native plan. Assert zero additional publication for the ordinary plan, then verify a genuinely new supervised proof can proceed while the original archive stays unchanged.
